en: Expansion to high mobility equipment -
“Availability dash unit”
*The MS body is not included with this product.
* To reproduce this image, you will need this product and the pre-assembly "MG 1/100 Gundam Astrea TYPE-F (Full Weapon Set)" (sold separately).
Single release of high-mobility equipment avalanche unit and dash unit that can be installed on MG Gundam Astrea TYPE-F (full weapon set).
● The same deep red coloring as Astrea TYPE-F is reproduced in the molding color.
● It is possible to transform to high-speed movement mode and open and close the dash unit's GN claw.
● Comes with a special clear green pedestal inspired by GN particles.
●A water transfer decal for the Avalanche dash unit is included.
<Set contents> Avalanche dash unit complete set / dedicated pedestal / water transfer decal
1/100 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used in the assembly.

This product is a set that can be installed on the pre-assembly "MG 1/100 Gundam Astrea TYPE-F (Full Weapon Set)" (sold separately) (product handled by Premium Bandai) to reproduce high-mobility equipment.
